title: TicTacToe AI
tagline: Tic Tac Toe app coded with minimax AI with varying difficulty levels
overview: Tic Tac Toe app with local multiplayer and a bot with varying difficulties.
problem: Develop a tic tac toe application with C where users (kids) can develop their initial stage of analytics thinking skill.
solution: Created a tic tac toe application where users can play against each other locally and against bots with varying difficulty levels to challenge them at their logical thinking level.
architecture:
C was used for the tic tac toe minimax algorithm and varying difficulties algorithm.
 The SDL2 was used for the GUI and game logic
metrics: Easy difficulty used minimax depth 1 where bot is able to foresee immediate repercussions of the next move, but not long term repercussions
Hard difficulty features minimax depth 8 (max depth first search)
Games are varied between each session for the same move
learningPoints: Implemented the minimax algorithm with depth control to balance performance and intelligence.
Gained experience integrating C game logic with an SDL2-based graphical interface
Learnt how to adapt AI algorithm into specific use case

challenges.title: Minimax Algorithm
challenges.description: Find out how to implement minimax algorithm depth first search into tic tac toe

challenges.title: Repetitive games
challenges.description: Varied games. Minimax typically chooses the best move, leading to boring games. Games were made to vary with AI still choosing the optimal move

challenges.title: Medium difficulty too easy/hard
challenges.description:
Setting difficulty to a singular depth of 3, 4 or 5 made the game too easy/difficult.
 Therefore, medium difficulty was chosen to vary between depths 3, 4 or 5
